changelog: Mesh nodes now only accept servers that share your network secret, so strangers can no longer use your server as a free EasyTier relay. New multi-thread mode runs EasyTier on more than one CPU core (on by default for new servers, a toggle for existing ones). New servers use EasyTier's MTU of 1360 for encrypted links, node settings saved from the panel are checked on the server and a failed save restores the previous working configuration, wg:// peer addresses work, and yes/no questions in the terminal setup accept only yes or no.
